description: This file defines the EmployeeSalaryDecorator class, which provides methods to manipulate EmployeeSalary objects by setting related entities such as Employee, PayPeriod, PayGrade, and CurrencyType using reference lookups.

classes.name: EmployeeSalaryDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for EmployeeSalary entity, allowing setting related entities via references.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with an EmployeeSalary instance.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee associated with the salary using an employee number.

methods.name: setPayPeriodById
methods.description: Sets the PayPeriod for the salary by its ID.

methods.name: setPayGradeById
methods.description: Sets the PayGrade for the salary by its ID.

methods.name: setCurrencyTypeById
methods.description: Sets the CurrencyType for the salary by its ID.
